title: Provide a Python client for the accounts API
description:
As a Python backend such as Papyrus or the Lab console, I want a shared client for the Prospectus accounts API.

Feature: Provide a Python client for the accounts API
  Scenario: Signed server call
    Given temporary runtime role credentials and a verified human access token
    When the client lists accounts, reads the directory or authorizes an operation
    Then it signs the request with SigV4 and returns the same shapes as the TypeScript client

The Lab console's Python BFF client lives in the Cyclotron repo; this would share it.
